checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One portrait 4:5 flyer with cheerful illustrated flowers
must.why: Image 2 is 512x640 (4:5) with illustrated flowers around a green border.
Reads correctly; dash looks like an en dash.
'Maple Park, East Gate' is clear and fully visible.

faults.what: Text block is small relative to the large empty yellow space; layout is a bit plain with a lot of unused space.
Flowers are pale and confined to the edges, so the look is slightly muted rather than very cheerful.
The date and time lines are tightly spaced.

summary: A clean 4:5 butter-yellow flyer with a flower border and all four text lines exact and legible, though the layout is plain with a lot of empty space.
